PROP-attendanceze-inv-010.text: Registration token must be single-use; completed_at check must prevent replay.
PROP-attendanceze-inv-010.assertion: forall token: completeTempReg(token) => token.completed_at == null (pre) && token.completed_at != null (post)

locations.note: STEM OAuth authorization codes are single-use: delete_authorization_code RPC is called immediately on line 83 before validation completes. This is the analogous single-use token mechanism in stem-system.
